description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'NamespacedEntityIdWithType' which extends 'EntityIdWithType' and implements 'NamespacedEntityId'. It provides functionality related to entity IDs with namespace awareness, including methods for getting namespace and name, checking compatibility with other entity IDs, and standard object methods like equals and hashCode.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdWithType
classes.description: An immutable base class for entity IDs that are aware of their namespace and type, providing mechanisms for validation and comparison of entity IDs within a namespace context.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new instance of NamespacedEntityIdWithType with a delegate entity ID.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the entity ID, delegated to the wrapped NamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name component of the entity ID, delegated to the wrapped NamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: isCompatibleOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if a given entity ID is compatible with this entity ID, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality considering the wrapped entity ID and entity type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the superclass hash, the wrapped entity ID, and entity type.
